passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the author.
David was a king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David often prayed to God.
David loved God.
David followed God.

passages.text: Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
passages.sermon:
David speaks these words.
David asks the LORD to judge him.
David says, "Vindicate me, O LORD."
David explains why he asks this.
David says, "I have walked with integrity."
David says, "I have trusted in the LORD."
David says, "I have not wavered."
passages.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־ אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃

passages.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks the LORD to test him.
David asks the LORD to try him.
David asks the LORD to examine his heart.
David asks the LORD to examine his mind.
passages.original: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צְרוֹפָה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃

passages.text: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is David.
David speaks to the LORD.
David sees the LORD’s loving devotion.
David keeps the LORD’s loving devotion before his eyes.
David walks in the LORD’s truth.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י וְ֝הִתְהַלַּ֗כְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
passages.sermon: The speaker is a servant of the LORD.\r\nThe speaker does not sit with deceitful men.\r\nThe speaker does not keep company with hypocrites.
passages.original: לֹא־ יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם־ מְתֵי־ שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a righteous person who loves God.
The speaker hates the group of evildoers.
The speaker refuses to sit with wicked people.
The speaker does not join with those who do evil.
passages.original: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם־ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב׃

passages.text: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD, to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
passages.sermon:
I am a person who seeks innocence.
I wash my hands to show my innocence.
I approach Your altar, O LORD.
I come to Your altar to give thanks.
I speak with a voice of thanksgiving.
I tell about all Your wonderful works.
passages.original: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃ לַ֭שְׁמִעַ בְּק֣וֹל תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ֝לְסַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, I speak to You.
You are God.
I love Your house.
Your house is where You live.
Your glory stays there.
Your glory fills that place.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed, in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks God for protection.
David says, “Do not take my soul away with sinners.”
David says, “Do not take my life with men of bloodshed.”
These men hold wicked schemes in their hands.
Their right hands are full of bribes.
passages.original: אַל־ תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־ חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־ אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃ אֲשֶׁר־ בִּידֵיהֶ֥ם זִמָּ֑ה וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם מָ֣לְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד׃

passages.text: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this passage.
David chooses to walk with integrity.
David asks God to redeem him.
David asks God to show him mercy.

passages.text: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
passages.sermon: David speaks in this passage.\r\nDavid says his feet stand on level ground.\r\nDavid says he will bless the LORD in the congregations.
passages.original: רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃
